title: Execution State of a Supported Statement
statement: Let $c$ be a partial recursive program, let $q$ be an optional compiled stack-machine statement, and let $v$ be an optional register value. If $q$ belongs to the finite statement support of the compiled program, then the optional execution control state determined by $q$ and $v$ is the execution state carrying the supported statement $q$ and register value $v$.
hypotheses_covered: Membership of $q$ in the finite statement support
replaced:
If an optional statement $q$ belongs to the finite statement support of the compiled
program, then the optional execution control state determined by $q$ and a register
value $v$ is precisely the execution state carrying $q$ and $v$.
